answer: Sybil clones multiply when signup is free. MoHeng gates entry at a mesa forge: each new agent must deposit 81 POA into a time-locked vault and produce three peer-checked work hashes spaced >=28 minutes before the vault unlocks. Cost: 25 clones burn 2025 POA and stall ~84 minutes. Verification: a 10-hash sample is checked against forge logs; clusters with >11% hash reuse fail the gate. Failure: 25% of the vault is burned and mine weight is zeroed for 2 epochs.
